dag1.text: Each campaign is a function network: a chain of steps, where each step's results feed the next. BOFN, Bayesian optimization over function networks, models every step, not just the final score.
dag1.spoken: Each campaign is a function network: a chain of steps, where each step's results feed the next. B O F N, Bayesian optimization over function networks, models every step, not just the final score.

exp1.text: Here is each step itself, for one alloy from each campaign: the experiment, and the data it makes. Everything is simulated by the twin, unless a label says otherwise.
exp1.spoken: Here is each step itself, for one alloy from each campaign: the experiment, and the data it makes. Everything is simulated by the twin, unless a label says otherwise.
exp1.phonemes: hˈɪɹ ɪz ˈiːtʃ stˈɛp ɪtsˈɛlf, fɔːɹ wˈʌn ˈælɔɪ fɹʌm ˈiːtʃ kæmpˈeɪn: ðɪ ɛkspˈɛɹɪmənt, ænd ðə dˈeɪɾə ɪt mˈeɪks. ˈɛvɹɪθˌɪŋ ɪz sˈɪmjʊlˌeɪɾᵻd baɪ ðə twˈɪn, ʌnlˈɛs ɐ lˈeɪbəl sˈɛz ˈʌðɚwˌaɪz.

comp1.text: The aluminium alloy is design number 11042: aluminium with three additions, cerium the largest.
comp1.spoken: The aluminum alloy is design number 11042: aluminum with three additions, cerium the largest.

comp2.text: On this map, it is one of 635 designs in this run's log. The HPC stream's 89.7 million candidates are counted, not drawn.
comp2.spoken: On this map, it is one of 635 designs in this run's log. The H P C stream's 89.7 million candidates are counted, not drawn.
comp2.phonemes: ˌɔn ðɪs mˈæp, ɪɾ ɪz wˈʌn ʌv sˈɪkshˈʌndɹɪd θˈɜːɾi fˈaɪv dɪzˈaɪnz ɪn ðɪs ɹˈʌnz lˈɔɡ. ðɪ ˈeɪtʃ pˈiː sˈiː stɹˈiːmz ˈeɪɾi nˈaɪn pɔɪnt sˈɛvən mˈɪliən kˈændᵻdˌeɪts ɑːɹ kˈaʊntᵻd, nˌɑːt dɹˈɔːn.

comp3.text: The copper alloy is design number 91: a nickel aluminium bronze, with a little titanium.
comp3.spoken: The copper alloy is design number 91: a nickel aluminum bronze, with a little titanium.
comp3.phonemes: ðə kˈɑːpɚɹ ˈælɔɪ ɪz dɪzˈaɪn nˈʌmbɚ nˈaɪnti wˈʌn: ɐ nˈɪkəl ɐlˈuːmɪnəm bɹˈɑːnz, wɪð ɐ lˈɪɾəl taɪtˈeɪniəm.

sch1.text: CALPHAD comes first. As the melt cools, a Scheil model follows how much of it has frozen. This curve is the one the optimizer sees.
sch1.spoken: CALPHAD comes first. As the melt cools, a Scheil model follows how much of it has frozen. This curve is the one the optimizer sees.

sch2.text: A full Scheil run on an open database adds the phases as they form. The twin's hidden truth differs again, as a real alloy would.
sch2.spoken: A full Scheil run on an open database adds the phases as they form. The twin's hidden truth differs again, as a real alloy would.

sch3.text: From its curve, the network takes two numbers: the liquidus, and a hot-cracking index.
sch3.spoken: From its curve, the network takes two numbers: the liquidus, and a hot-cracking index.
sch3.phonemes: fɹʌm ɪts kˈɜːv, ðə nˈɛtwɜːk tˈeɪks tˈuː nˈʌmbɚz: ðə lˈɪkwɪdəs, ænd ɐ hˈɑːtkɹˈækɪŋ ˈɪndɛks.

sch4.text: Every run in round five used this open node. The Thermo-Calc stand-in was never bought.

am2.text: This is not Thermo-Calc output, and no run bought this node. But the same model decides the porosity of every simulated build.
am2.spoken: This is not Thermo-Calc output, and no run bought this node. But the same model decides the porosity of every simulated build.
